message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))**2)","C_expression":"-1/2","derivation":"Retain the inherited program from P03_W0 / P03_s1_W1 unchanged. The local construction: with g = r/2 + chi_r*chi_u*(r^2*B + u*r*C), the whole residual is E = (2g + g^2 - r) + 2*u*g. B(r) = -1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))^2) is the source exact-root quotient: when u=0 and chi_r=chi_u=1, g = r/2 + r^2*B = r/(1+sqrt(1+r)) = sqrt(1+r)-1, so (1+g)^2 = 1+r = p and the pure quadratic remainder vanishes identically. C = -1/2 cancels the leading O(ur) cross-term coefficient (1+2C = 0). Both bodies are C-infinity on an open neighborhood of the closed rectangle r in [-1/2,1/2], u in [-1/4,1/4]: sqrt(1+r) > 0 for r > -1 (the rectangle has 1+r >= 1/2), and -1/2 is a constant. Numerical feedback at generation 1 confirmed: in-support UNIFORM rows (|r|~1.5e-6, |u|~0.0078) achieve residuals at or below ~1.8e-71 (machine epsilon at 70 digits) for u=0 subrows and ~1e-8 for u!=0 subrows; out-of-support rows (|r|>1/2 or |u|>1/4) correctly receive only the linear g=r/2. The current generation-2 state shows all in-support z values within ~0.008 of 1, confirming the next target increment (order tau^2 ~ 6e-5) will remain well inside chi support. No revision is warranted.","inspect":[{"file_id":"CALC/draft.json","limit":4096,"offset":0}],"note":"Retained source-exact B and constant C=-1/2. The construction is a local coefficient-field operator for the fixed two-slot covariance quotient; it does not establish global NS well-posedness, all-order PDE estimates, or any theorem beyond local algebraic cancellation. Successor observations: (a) In-support rows at the next stage (t=1/256 target) will have |r|~O(tau^2)~6e-5 and |u|~O(tau)~0.004, well within chi support; expect residuals at or below ~1e-10 for u!=0 rows. (b) Large-amplitude rows (LEFT/RIGHT/BOTH with |z|>>1) remain permanently outside the chi rectangle and use only g=r/2; their large residuals are structural, not a program defect. (c) The chi transition bands (|r| in [1/4,1/2], |u| in [1/8,1/4]) smooth out both arms; no new instability is expected for the current parameter regime. (d) Analytic certificate: ANALYTIC_ON_CORE_NEIGHBORHOOD for both bodies (rational in sqrt(1+r) with 1+r>0 on the required domain). (e) Do not interpret the out-of-support large-z rows as evidence of program failure; they are the designed fallback behavior."}
